definitions.explanation: Loud, unpleasant, or unwanted sound that disturbs or annoys.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{騒音|そうおん}がひどい。
{騒音|そうおん}で{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep because of the noise.

examples.japanese: {騒音|そうおん}{問題|もんだい}で{住民|じゅうみん}が{苦情|くじょう}を{言|い}っている。
examples.english: Residents are complaining about the noise problem.

notes:
{騒音|そうおん} specifically refers to noise that is bothersome or disruptive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騒音|そうおん}{問題|もんだい} (noise problem)
- {騒音|そうおん}{規制|きせい} (noise regulation)
- {騒音|そうおん}{公害|こうがい} (noise pollution)
- {交通|こうつう}{騒音|そうおん} (traffic noise)
- {騒音|そうおん}を{立|た}てる (to make noise)

COMPARISON:
- {騒音|そうおん}: noise (bothersome, disruptive)
- {音|おと}: sound (neutral)
- {物音|ものおと}: sounds, noises (general sounds)
